source_evidence_limits: The source-attributed occurrence inventory was read in full. Retain the existing roles and confidence; no new full-text retrieval or canonical current-edition restamp is claimed. Later correction, sanctions, vacatur or withdrawal do not erase original reliance.

The judge’s research use does not establish AI authorship of the entire order. FC-016 remains a candidate only: source error is established but the actual omitted check is not reconstructed. No prosecution is distinct from the factual source defect and possible discipline.
